candidate_evidence.quote: Carboplatin infusion on the day of Exablate BBBD procedure to treat cancerous cells in the brain
to establish the safety and feasibility of blood-brain-barrier disruption (BBBD) combined with intravenous carboplatin for the treatment of rGBM

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Tumor progression after first line chemo radiation

role_evidence.quote: On the day of planned carboplatin therapy, subjects will undergo Exablate procedure to open the blood-brain-barrier in the targeted cancerous brain areas prior to Carboplatin administration.

agents.agent_name_registered: microbubble resonators (part of Exablate BBBD device intervention)

role_evidence.quote: BBB opening via Exablate Neuro Type 2 system with microbubble resonators.
Known sensitivity or contraindications to ultrasound contrast agent or perflutren

agents.drug_class_hint: ultrasound contrast microbubbles used with focused ultrasound for BBB opening

coder_notes: Carboplatin is coded as a candidate with device_dependent true because focused-ultrasound BBB opening for its delivery is the question (R5: C12 overrides C3, although patients were already planned for carboplatin). Microbubbles are not a separate registered intervention; they are named in the device intervention text, and the moiety perflutren is inferred from the exclusion criterion mentioning perflutren. Gadolinium contrast is used for the BBBD imaging outcome and is not a registered intervention, so it is not listed. The contrast-intensity outcome measures BBB opening, not carboplatin target engagement, so target_engagement_planned is no.
